'''Maker''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of an unknown [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] or [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Human/Legends|human]] who was created in an [[Imperial research facility]] on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==Biography==
Maker was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of an unknown [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] that was created, along with other clones, by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in a [[Imperial research facility|research facility]] on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], as part of a cloning program that was initiated by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], although it was unknown who was his template. Later the newly constituted [[Community]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] and overthrew the Imperial forces that operated the research facility. For many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Maker and all the clones resided on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and only in [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]], they escaped the facility by stealing a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] that had been flown to the moon by the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] agent [[Kell Douro]] but unfortunately Alpha was killed by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]].

Maker and all of the other members of the Community, with the exception of the clone [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]], suffered from a sickness as a result of their clone heritage and as they escaped from the research facility, the CloakShape passed through the remnants of the [[Lignan]] cargo of the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']], which had been destroyed a short time earlier. The Lignan enhanced the clones' perception of the Force and accelerated the effects of their sickness. Driven mad by the Lignan ore and the death of [[Scar (clone)|Scar]], his mate, Maker began a feud with [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]], which ended in his death by [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|Force choke]]. Seer believed that the illness was a test that had been set for the clones by [[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]] and she then ordered Soldier to fly the CloakShape fighter to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]], so that the clones could obtain [[Metacycline|some medication]], and planned for the clones to then travel to find Mother.

==Behind the scenes==
The book never revealed who was the template of Maker. Vague clues hinted that it was the unknown [[Lassin]].
